settings.text: Made in small batches in the UK

settings.heading: What it's made of
settings.content:
It depends what you're looking at:

  • Stickers — thick matte vinyl, waterproof, dishwasher-safe on a bottle.
  • Prints — 300gsm uncoated card, printed with pigment inks.
  • Bandanas & totes — soft 100% cotton.
  • Keyrings & pins — acrylic and enamel, with a proper metal fitting.

settings.heading: Looking after it
settings.content: Stickers survive rain, bottles and dishwashers, but not a scouring pad. Prints prefer to stay out of direct sunlight. Anything cotton takes a cold wash, inside out, hung to dry — never a tumble dryer.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
Posted within two working days in a recycled mailer. UK delivery 1–2 days after that; free over £35. Worldwide shipping is calculated at checkout.

Returns within 30 days, unused, with sticker sheets unopened. Message me and I'll sort it.
